hook: GHMC collects Diwali puja waste at *12* temples on Nov 14
hook_b: GHMC collects Diwali puja waste at *12* temples on Nov 14
tldr: GHMC's Project Udvasana sacred-waste collection drive returns on Nov 14 at 12 temples across Hyderabad.

beats.what: Telangana Today reports GHMC will run its Project Udvasana collection drive at 12 temples on November 14.
beats.why: Udvasana collects worshipped items (idols, photos, flowers, puja leftovers) so they are not dumped in lakes or bins.
beats.care: Post-Deepavali puja leftovers can be dropped at the collection temples instead of the garbage.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: GHMC to launch Project Udvasana collection drive at 12 temples on November 14. Deccan Chronicle earlier reported GHMC expanding the drive from 6 to 12 centres.
